mechanism: MIR building passes `global: &Global` to complete_fill as a reborrow `_466 = &(*global)` (coercion site).

Once Account::deref is MIR-inlined, ReferencePropagation rewrites that reborrow as `&((*box).account)`, so rustc emits a fresh gep +8 in the call block (bb64) and leaves the binding's gep in bb57 dead.
LLVM EarlyCSE then reuses the whitelist chain's gep +8 from bb58.
InstCombine folds the whitelist chain to +648 and sinks the +8 gep to the top of bb64 (unique predecessor bb58). An llc oracle with the gep anywhere in bb64 gives 18 slots.
A plain local helper does not help: after its own MIR inlining of Account::deref it is a leaf, so cross_crate_inlinable is true and the MIR inliner inlines it.

#[cold] makes the MIR inliner refuse the helper. The LLVM inliner still inlines it into bb57, the gep keeps its single use in bb64, InstCombine cannot sink it, and MachineSink places it as in the original.
